The issue resides in the function where it adds an amount to the stakes mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the case where the stakes mapping is under an attacker's control, it can lead to a total supply manipulation.

The 'unstake' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it subtracts an amount from the stakes mapping without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the case where the stakes mapping is under an attacker's control, it can lead to a total supply manipulation.

The 'deposit' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue resides in the function where it adds a _value to the caller's balance without a check, allowing the total supply to become very large, in the case where the balances mapping is under an attacker's control, it can lead to a total supply manipulation.

The mint function is Typo Constructor, it can be exploited to steal funds from users, attackers can call the mint function to mint unlimited tokens and transfer them to attacker controlled addresses, allowing attackers to drain assets from user accounts.
